Annexure - C
Terms & Conditions for {{ tnc.title }}

3. This service contract shall be entered into as aforesaid only after due checking and verification of the equipment by the company’s authorized representative certifying that the same is in good working condition. During such verification if the air conditioner is found defective and needs repairing, then the same shall be repaired on the request of the customer on chargeable basis and thereafter the contract in respect of the AMC shall be entered into. In such case/s the cost of repair and spare parts shall be borne by the customer separately as the same shall not form the part of annual charges payable under this contract. The company is at the sole discretion to enter into an AMC with the customer. The company‘s decision in this regard shall be final and binding on the customer.

4. The Contract will not cover visits/replacement/repairing of parts and/or equipment under the following circumstances:

(i) Damage caused to the machine due to floods, fire, accident, riot, breakage, pest, misuse, improper or negligent use, mishandling, unauthorized alteration, modification or substitution of any part and/or the alteration, tempering etc. of the serial no. machine and/or any loss/damage caused due to abnormal voltage supply (Please note that the power supply required should be 220V + 5% for 1-Phase machine and 415+5% for 3-Phase Products.)

(ii) Air conditioning units failure due to incoming voltage unbalance, Fluctuation, Single phasing, Problems in electrical panel or due to atmospheric conditions.

(iii) Damage caused to the machine/equipment due to failure in abiding with the operating instructions and precautions as mentioned in the User’s Manual.

(iv) Defects due to usage of non-recommended spare/s and accessories.

(v) Defects /failures resulting from servicing/repairs done by a person other than authorized representative of the company.

(vi) This Annual Maintenance Contract ceases to exist in case the machine has been attended to for any type of repair by any unauthorized person at any point of time during the AMC period.

In case the customer, as a result of the aforesaid causes, requires the services then the same shall be provided at extra cost, payable by the customer. No AMC amount paid by the customer shall be refunded or adjusted on pro rata basis for unutilized period.

5. Additional Services other than four Preventive maintenance services required due to wrong usage, dirty or polluted inside and outside surroundings will be done on additional cost. Prices can be mutually agreed before doing additional services.

6. This contract does not hold any temperature guarantee for the premises having Products installed with lower / under capacity at initial stage and/or mentioned initially/later by company.

7. The Company shall make reasonable efforts & endeavour to give preferential attention to emergency breakdown of the equipment, however the company shall not be held responsible for any loss/damage arising thereby. The company shall not be held responsible for any delay/default in servicing whatsoever due to any reasons beyond its control.

8. This contract and the annual maintenance/repair charges paid hereby are non-transferable and non-refundable under any circumstances whatsoever. The payment under this contract is a one-time payment for the entire term of the contract till its expiry. {{ tnc.c8 }}

9. This contract does not cover the repair / replacement of plastic parts, air filters, heaters, electricity distribution boards, MCCB/ MCB/ ELCB, ancillary work such as ducting / masonry work, cabinet sheet metal panels, evaporator coil, condenser coils, Y-Branch, replacement of refrigerant pipe and its insulation, shifting of units in part or as a whole. Also it does not cover the replacement of any major parts such as evaporator / condenser as a whole.

10. {{ tnc.c10 }}

11. The Company shall endeavour to send service engineer within 24 hours of the complaint made by the Customer. The contract is not transferable in event of resale / gift to any other person and no refund shall be given.

12. The Company has the right to terminate this contract forthwith in the event of a) any non-compliance/breach of the terms of this contract by customer; b) unauthorized service/repair/maintenance carried out by customer; c) any force majeure event in terms of which it is not possible to carry out the contract; and/or d) without any cause. The contract will automatically terminate on the expiry of the AMC period. In case the customer wants to cancel the contract before the completion of the contract period, there shall be no refund of the charges for unexpired period.

13. This contract is final and binding on both the parties, no separate invoice or agreement shall be issued.

14. This contract sets out the terms and conditions which the company and customer hereby agrees to abide with and it cancels and supersedes all prior agreements, undertakings or arrangements, oral or written between the parties on the subject matter. The company in its own discretion may accept or reject any proposal of entering into the service maintenance contract.

15. In the event of any dispute arising out of or related to this contract which cannot be resolved through negotiations between the parties, the same shall be settled by the Courts at {{ tnc.court }} without prejudice to the above; all disputes under this contract are subject to resolution in terms of the Arbitration & Conciliation Act. The seat & venue shall be Noida and language shall be English.
